alignment_conflict.claim: Early prose ("The Debate at T’karas") frames Sira Velkonn as the REFORMIST leader hosting Union envoys on T’karas Prime.
alignment_conflict.canon_position: Imperial Loyalist — a pro-monarchy High-Houses figure, the fixed rival pole against whom the Republican Reformist Thalen Rynn is defined.
alignment_conflict.status: RESOLVED 2026-08-09 — canon position confirmed; the Reformist framing is a mis-attribution.
resolution_basis: A full character profile recovered from the same archive states it outright three ways: role "Heir-Apparent of the Velar Imperium (Imperial Loyalist)", allegiance "Velar Imperium (Imperial Loyalist Faction)", and a reputation line reading "+10 Imperial Loyalist Respect … −6 Republican Reformist Trust".
Her core directives are restorationist — "Reclaim the Throne of the Imperium".
The same source’s faction table lists "Sira Velkonn, Velkonn House Fleet" under the Imperial Loyalists.

Independent corroboration against committed canon: her mentor Talyx Velkonn is canon’s exiled Grand Duke restorationist; her rival Jaxx Tyren is canon’s Warlord of the Outer Colonies; her covert tie Valcor is a canon alias; and loc_nyros_expanse ALREADY records that Velar restorationist loyalist houses reactivated ancient fleets there — the exact action her profile attributes to her.
alignment_conflict.mechanism_for_the_misattribution: Her profile records that she "covertly contacted Union diplomats under a false identity" and held "secret diplomatic ties" with a senior Union figure. A Loyalist engaging the Union covertly is precisely the kind of actor a later summary could mis-record as a Reformist host. This is offered as the likely explanation of the drift; the source does NOT state that the T’karas debate was that contact, and no such identification is asserted.
alignment_conflict.effect_on_canon: None — the canon position is unchanged. The conflict is retained as recorded history of how it was resolved, not as an open question.
